title: Caffarelli–Kohn–Nirenberg partial regularity
abstract: Partial regularity for three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes suitable weak solutions with locally L^q forcing, q > 5/2: quantitative epsilon regularity and vanishing parabolic one-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the singular set. Includes the supporting Sobolev, singular integral, pressure, heat-potential and parabolic Morrey infrastructure, equivalence of suitable-solution formulations, and a nonzero shear-flow example. Includes the completed Leray, pressure, and linear regularity support needed by further Navier–Stokes regularity projects.

informal.CKN.epsilonRegularityL3: For q > 5/2, sufficiently small unit-cylinder L^3 velocity, L^(3/2) pressure and L^q force masses give an almost-everywhere equal quantitatively bounded parabolic Holder representative on the closed half-cylinder and regularity at each point of its open interior.
informal.CKN.epsilonRegularityGradient: A sufficiently small extended nonnegative limsup of the normalized squared weak-gradient mass implies regularity at an interior point of a suitable weak solution.
informal.CKN.caffarelliKohnNirenberg: The singular set of a suitable weak solution with locally L^q forcing, q > 5/2, has zero one-dimensional Hausdorff measure in the parabolic metric.
informal.CKN.isSuitableWeakSolution_iff_integrabl: The manuscript's suitable weak-solution predicate is equivalent to the predicate that explicitly requires integrability of all tested weak-equation and local-energy integrands.
informal.CKN.isSuitableWeakSolutionIntegrable_she: The nonzero decaying sinusoidal shear flow with zero pressure and force is a suitable weak solution on all space and times in (0,1).
